title: Comfort Club Refundable Dues and the Date of Notice
content:
For Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements cancelled on an annually billed agreement, the refundable dues of the current term depend on when the member gave notice.

**Notice date.** The notice date is the date the pending cancellation request was received. It is counted in calendar days with the term start as day 0.

## Refund basis rule
1. **Notice within the full-refund window** — no later than the tier's full-refund window after the current term began (30 calendar days on every Comfort Club tier): the refundable dues are the term dues billed **in full**.
2. **Notice after that window but no later than the long-standing notice window of 60 calendar days after the term began, and the agreement is in at least its tenth consecutive term** (a consecutive term count of 10 or more): the refundable dues are the term dues billed multiplied by the calendar days from the date of handling to the term end, divided by 365, rounded to the cent half up.
3. **In every other case** this rule does not change the refundable dues.

## Decision table

| Notice day (term start is day 0) | Consecutive term count | Refundable dues |
|---|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | any | term dues billed in full |
| 31 to 60 | 10 or more | term dues billed, times days to term end, divided by 365 |
| 31 to 60 | 9 or fewer | not changed by this rule |
| 61 or later | any | not changed by this rule |

## Worked example (hypothetical)
Term 1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026, term dues billed 479.00, agreement in its 12th consecutive term. Request received 15 April 2025 (day 45); date of handling 20 April 2025. Calendar days from 20 April 2025 to 28 February 2026: 314. Refundable dues: 479.00 multiplied by 314, divided by 365, is 412.0712..., rounded half up to 412.07.

Same dates on an agreement in its 9th term: day 45 is past the 30-day window and the term count is below 10, so this rule does not change the refundable dues.

## Boundary points
- Request received on day 30: inside the full-refund window.
- Request received on day 60 by an agreement in its 10th term: inside the long-standing notice window.
